Peer learning: Collaborate with other participants across disciplines and backgrounds.
Evaluation & feedback: Receive expert mentorship and constructive feedback that you can use for future projects or interviews.
Innovation mindset: Push your limits and discover new ways of thinking under pressure.

FAQs
01. Are these guest lectures and hackathons part of the curriculum?
They are not mandatory, but strongly encouraged. They are designed to complement your core learning and give you practical industry exposure.
02. Can I participate in hackathons if I’m from a non-technical background?
Absolutely! DSU hosts hackathons and ideathons for both technical and business-focused students. Whether you are doing a BBA or BCA, there is something for everyone.
03. How often are these events held?
Guest lectures and hackathons are hosted regularly throughout the academic year. Students are notified in advance and can choose sessions relevant to their interests.
04. Will participation in these events be added to my academic records or resume?
Yes. Certificates of participation and achievement are provided. These can boost your profile for internships, jobs, or higher education applications.
05. Do I need any extra tools or software to participate in online events?
Most sessions are conducted using tools already available through DSU’s learning platform. If anything additional is required, students are guided well in advance.
